summary: Fixed live view counters that could never go down: the dashboard kept 75 views on v-20261026-03 after YouTube removed invalid views and showed 57. All checks clean.
why: Tonight's data audit had one ahead_of_youtube warning (75 vs 57); the cause was the GREATEST rule in lib/live-stats.ts. The three unlisted long videos are an owner setting (fourth audit in a row).

findings.title: Three long videos still unlisted on YouTube

changes.title: Live counters follow real drops on YouTube
changes.detail: nextLiveCount() keeps the larger number on a small cached dip (2 or 2%) and follows a bigger drop; tests in workers/tests/dashboard-live-counter.test.ts.
